title: A股科技开盘确认、港股继续承压，广钢回购获价格验证 + 美股盘前：NVDA治理风波拖累纳指期货跌0.86%；AMD、AVGO与TTEK逆势
summary: 截至11月12日10:18 CST，上证、深证、创业板和科创50分别涨0.45%、0.96%、1.60%和4.50%，CPO与存储链延续隔夜映射；恒指跌1.14%，恒生科技约跌1.3%，港股黄金股跌5%至6%，跨市场分化扩大。北京具身智能机器人行动方案与央行1970亿元净投放补充政策支持。广钢气体公告后涨5.71%，升级为看多候选；金杯电工微跌维持条件关注，久日新材继续回避。 07:03 ET，道指期货涨0.03%、标普500期货跌0.40%、纳指100期货跌0.86%；NVDA因董事会据报考虑CEO去留而跌7.7%，CRWV、MU、MRVL与数据中心链同步承压。AMD、AVGO与TTEK获得正向价格反馈；今晚CSCO与AMAT财报、周五PPI将验证科技估值与加息风险。

国际
伊朗核问题与航运风险推高油价
伊朗拒绝将浓缩核材料运出境外，谈判不确定性与霍尔木兹海峡航运袭击风险升温；布伦特原油结算涨1.39%至92.76美元，WTI涨0.57%至86.53美元。能源链受益与输入性通胀压力并存。 来源

纳指、标普500和道指分别收涨1.60%、1.31%和0.49%，标普科技板块涨2.7%；热通胀与鹰派表态令美元指数升0.7%至102.92，美债现金市场因退伍军人日休市。 来源
政策
传音控股调入沪港通下港股通标的
上交所下属中投信11月11日公告，02636传音控股自下一港股通交易日起调入标的名单，为南向资金可达性提供制度增量，但不等于资金流入或价格确认。 来源

工业产品碳足迹标准清单扩围
工信部等四部门公布第四批工业产品碳足迹核算规则团体标准推荐清单，为相关制造业披露、绿色供应链和出口合规提供统一口径；受益仍取决于企业订单与执行。 来源

北京市经信局11月11日发布行动方案，提出到2028年培育不少于5家国际一流、10家国内领先的人形机器人整机企业，京津冀整机产能占全国25%、关键零部件配套率超过60%。早盘机器人概念走强，但公司级受益仍需业务和订单核验。 来源

截至10:18 CST，科创50涨4.50%、创业板涨1.60%；剑桥科技涨10.00%，中际旭创、新易盛、天孚通信和源杰科技涨3.64%至4.89%，翔港科技涨6.18%。隔夜硬件与存储映射已获本地价格确认，但上涨家数仍少于下跌家数。
科技

存储概念涨10.72%、英伟达持仓概念涨7.41%，SNDK涨13.69%、CRWV涨24.71%；计算机硬件、半导体行业分别涨8.73%、5.18%。A/H映射集中在存储、芯片设备与消费电子，但不能用美股主题涨幅替代本地个股催化。 来源

英伟达盘后急跌构成AI反转信号
英伟达现金时段涨2.9%，但Reuters援引报道显示其盘后约跌8%；该反向信号削弱CRWV和存储链的隔夜正面外溢，今日A/H科技判断优先看开盘承接而非追随收盘涨幅。 来源
公司
广钢气体推出2亿至4亿元回购预案
回购上限41.82元，拟用于员工持股或股权激励，期限12个月；11月12日10:18报28.14元、涨5.71%，公告后价格与科创50同向走强，升级为看多候选；仍需跟踪回购执行。 来源

公司中标华润置地2026至2027年度低压电力电缆集采，含税金额约6.61亿元；不含税金额约占2025年营收2.88%，且正式合同尚未签订。11月12日10:18报10.34元、跌0.19%，公告后未形成相对强势，维持条件关注。 来源

美股夜盘行情总结

宽基
夜盘指数
截至08:12–08:14 CST，QQQ、SPY、DIA最新可得延长时段成交较前收分别约+2.28%、+1.32%、+0.51%。这些是ETF夜盘代理，不是股指期货；成交时间不同但均为近时点快照。
代表股
板块对照
SCKT、FPS、MX、AXTI、SNDK、CRWV、CANG、MU与RDGT最新可得报价方向与对应隔夜分组一致，确认硬件、半导体、存储和加密矿企强势；ARAI、IBG、SUNS、BGL、LODE批量查询未返回可用报价。英伟达盘后约跌8%，对“英伟达持仓概念”构成潜在反转。
映射
A/H 映射
存储、半导体与CPO已在A股开盘获得价格确认，但恒指跌1.14%、恒生科技约跌1.3%，港股黄金股跌5%至6%。跨市场分化意味着科技多头仅限已确认的A股分支；若午前回落并弱于宽基，则确认失效。

盘前结论

事实层面，截至10:18 CST，上证、深证、创业板和科创50分别涨0.45%、0.96%、1.60%和4.50%，CPO与存储链普遍走强。隔夜科技映射已经在A股开盘获得价格确认。

港股未同步：恒指跌1.14%，恒生科技约跌1.3%，港股黄金股跌5%至6%。机器人政策与央行净投放支持结构性题材，但短线判断采用“A股科技确认、港股风险偏好偏弱”的分化信号。

广钢气体公告后涨5.71%，升级为看多候选。金杯电工微跌、正式合同未签，维持条件关注；久日新材继续下跌，维持回避。

重点个股关注

广钢气体
688548.SH
看多候选

事实与状态：拟以2亿至4亿元回购股份，价格上限41.82元；11月12日10:18报28.14元、涨5.71%，公告后与科创50同向走强，获得个股和板块价格确认。

确认条件：午前维持相对科创50强势，成交承接稳定，且资金来源和回购进度继续落地。

风险与失效条件：回购用于激励而非直接注销，执行可部分或终止；若回落至前收下方并持续弱于科创50，撤销看多状态。

金杯电工
002533.SZ
条件关注

事实与状态：获约6.61亿元低压电缆集采中标通知，不含税金额约占2025年营收2.88%；11月12日10:18报10.34元、跌0.19%，公告后暂未形成正面价格确认。

确认条件：正式合同签署、履约节奏清晰，且后续股价与电气设备链形成可持续相对强势。

风险与失效条件：合同尚未签署且收入占比较小；若公告后价格无承接或项目落地延期，则事件价值不足。

久日新材
688199.SH
回避

事实与状态：重大交易需2.25亿欧元注资并承担2600万欧元递延付款，目标资产亏损且净资产为负；11月12日10:18报23.78元、跌3.49%，在前一日显著下跌后继续走弱。

确认条件：仅在融资结构、债务豁免、审批和目标现金流出现实质改善，且价格脱离持续弱势后重新评估。

风险与失效条件：跨境审批、追加注资、持续亏损、负净资产及商誉风险均属实质利空，当前不包装为多头。

板块轮动看板

受益方向CPO、存储、半导体设备与工业气体已获A股价格确认。
观察方向具身智能机器人受政策催化，但需公司业务与订单核验；金杯中标仍待合同和价格确认。
压力方向港股科技、港股黄金及高资金负担并购承受市场或公司级反证。
验证信号A股科技午前维持强于宽基、恒生科技止跌；若同步回落则降低评级。

逻辑链

隔夜硬件、存储、半导体领涨 → A股CPO与存储开盘走强 → 美股映射获得本地确认。
英伟达盘后反转 → 港股科技继续下跌 → 科技多头限于已确认的A股分支。
机器人行动方案与央行净投放 → 结构性政策支持增强 → 仍需业务订单和市场广度验证。
广钢回购后涨5.71% → 个股与科创板块同向确认 → 升级为看多候选。
金杯未确认、久日继续走弱 → 公司级反证分化 → 分别维持条件关注与回避。

风险雷达

英伟达盘后反转尚未消失，午前A股科技若回落将削弱确认。
油价和美元同步上行，增加输入性通胀与成长估值压力。
久日新材的融资、跨境审批、持续亏损与商誉风险未消。
金杯公告后仍未转强；广钢若跌回前收以下则看多确认失效。
09:48市场上涨家数少于下跌家数，指数走强尚非全面普涨。

数据来源与时间点

首轮截止2026-11-12 08:34 CST；增量复核截止10:18 CST。A/H指数与候选价格来自东方财富延迟行情，10:18快照；A股涨跌家数为09:48公开盘中统计。AKShare基线仍为2026-11-11 14:23:09 CST盘中快照，不冒充今日盘中数据。隔夜美股排行由GitHub Actions/Moomoo于10:17:24 CST刷新，QQQ/SPY/DIA为08:12–08:14 CST最后可得延长时段ETF代理。政策来源包括北京市政府官方行动方案及央行操作公开报道；公司事实来源保持上交所/巨潮索引与公告全文。

PositiveNegativeNeutralw1-w5 indicate heat/importance, not percentage moves.
Major News
Global
Iran nuclear stance and shipping risks lift oil
Iran rejected moving enriched material abroad as negotiation uncertainty and attacks around Hormuz raised shipping risk. Brent settled 1.39% higher at $92.76 and WTI gained 0.57% to $86.53, supporting energy exposure while renewing imported-inflation pressure. Source
Global
Tech lifts US stocks while the dollar strengthens
The Nasdaq, S&P 500 and Dow closed up 1.60%, 1.31% and 0.49%, and S&P technology rose 2.7%. Hot inflation and hawkish commentary pushed the dollar index 0.7% higher to 102.92; cash Treasuries were closed for Veterans Day. Source
Policy
Transsion added to Shanghai Stock Connect southbound list
SSE subsidiary China Investment Information said on Nov. 11 that 02636 Transsion would enter the eligible list from the next trading day. This improves southbound accessibility but is not evidence of inflows or price confirmation. Source
Policy
Industrial carbon-footprint standards list expands
MIIT and three other departments released a fourth batch of recommended association standards for industrial product carbon-footprint accounting, improving consistency for disclosure, green supply chains and export compliance. Benefits still depend on execution and orders. Source
Policy
Beijing issues a three-year embodied-intelligence robot plan
Beijing’s economy and IT authority said on Nov. 11 that by 2028 the city aims to foster at least five internationally leading and ten domestically leading humanoid OEMs, lift Beijing-Tianjin-Hebei capacity to 25% of the national total and key-parts coverage above 60%. Robot shares strengthened, but issuer benefits still require business and order evidence. Source
Liquidity
PBOC injects a net RMB197bn through reverse repos
The PBOC conducted RMB384bn of overnight reverse repos at 1.25% on Nov. 12. After RMB187bn matured, the net injection was RMB197bn, supporting morning liquidity without removing Hong Kong’s greater sensitivity to the dollar and external rates. Source
Tech
Mainland semiconductors, optical and storage names confirm at the open
As of 10:18 CST, STAR 50 was up 4.50% and ChiNext 1.60%. Cambridge Industries gained 10.00%; Zhongji Innolight, Eoptolink, TFC Optical and Yuanjie Technology rose 3.64%–4.89%, and Xianggang Technology gained 6.18%. The US hardware/storage mapping received local price confirmation, although decliners still outnumbered advancers.
Tech
Storage and AI infrastructure lead overnight US themes
Data storage rose 10.72% and NVIDIA Portfolio gained 7.41%, with SNDK up 13.69% and CRWV up 24.71%. Computer hardware and semiconductors rose 8.73% and 5.18%. The A/H read-through centers on memory, chip equipment and consumer electronics, but US theme performance cannot replace issuer-specific local catalysts. Source
Tech
NVIDIA after-hours drop signals an AI reversal
NVIDIA gained 2.9% in cash trading, but Reuters reported an approximately 8% after-hours fall. That reversal weakens the positive spillover from CRWV and storage; today’s A/H technology call prioritizes opening follow-through over chasing the overnight close. Source
Company
Guanggang Gases proposes a RMB200m–400m buyback
The cap is RMB41.82 per share, with shares intended for employee ownership or incentives over 12 months. At 10:18 on Nov. 12 the stock was RMB28.14, up 5.71%, moving with STAR 50 after the filing; it is upgraded to Bullish Candidate while execution remains to be monitored. Source
Company
Goldcup Electric wins RMB661m cable procurement notice
The company won China Resources Land’s 2026–2027 low-voltage cable procurement. The ex-tax amount equals about 2.88% of 2025 revenue and a formal contract is not yet signed. At 10:18 on Nov. 12 it was RMB10.34, down 0.19%, showing no positive post-announcement relative strength; it remains Conditional Watch. Source
Company
Jiuri New Materials receives a sharp negative reaction
At 10:18 on Nov. 12 the stock was RMB23.78, down 3.49%, extending the prior day’s sharp fall. The EUR225m injection, EUR26m deferred payment and loss-making target risks remain unresolved; the stock stays Avoid. Source

US Overnight Trading Summary

Broad
Overnight indices
As of 08:12–08:14 CST, the latest available extended-hours trades in QQQ, SPY and DIA were about +2.28%, +1.32% and +0.51% versus prior closes. These are ETF proxies, not index futures; timestamps differ slightly but are near-contemporaneous.
Representatives
Sector cross-check
Latest available quotes for SCKT, FPS, MX, AXTI, SNDK, CRWV, CANG, MU and RDGT matched their overnight group directions, confirming hardware, semiconductor, storage and crypto-mining strength. Batch queries returned no usable quotes for ARAI, IBG, SUNS, BGL and LODE. NVIDIA’s roughly 8% after-hours fall is a potential reversal for NVIDIA Portfolio.
Mapping
A/H mapping
Storage, semiconductors and optical names have received A-share opening confirmation, but HSI fell 1.14%, Hang Seng Tech about 1.3%, and Hong Kong gold shares 5%–6%. The divergence confines the long signal to confirmed mainland branches; a fade below broad indices before noon invalidates it.

Pre-open Conclusion

As of 10:18 CST, the Shanghai Composite, Shenzhen Component, ChiNext and STAR 50 were up 0.45%, 0.96%, 1.60% and 4.50%, while optical and storage shares broadly strengthened. The overnight technology mapping has received A-share opening price confirmation.

Hong Kong did not follow: HSI was down 1.14%, Hang Seng Tech roughly 1.3%, and Hong Kong gold shares 5%–6%. The robot plan and PBOC net injection support structural themes, but the tactical signal is “mainland technology confirmed, Hong Kong risk appetite weak.”

Guanggang Gases rose 5.71% after its filing and is upgraded to Bullish Candidate. Goldcup was slightly lower with no signed contract and stays Conditional Watch; Jiuri extended its decline and remains Avoid.

Stocks to Watch

Guanggang Gases
688548.SH
Bullish Candidate

Facts and status:The company proposed RMB200m–400m of buybacks capped at RMB41.82. At 10:18 on Nov. 12 it was RMB28.14, up 5.71%, strengthening with STAR 50 after the filing and gaining issuer/sector price confirmation.

Confirmation condition:It sustains relative strength versus STAR 50 before noon, with stable volume support and continued funding/execution progress.

Risks and invalidation:Shares are intended for incentives rather than immediate cancellation and execution may be partial or terminated. A drop below the prior close with sustained underperformance versus STAR 50 revokes the bullish status.

Goldcup Electric
002533.SZ
Conditional Watch

Facts and status:It received a RMB661m low-voltage cable award; the ex-tax amount equals about 2.88% of 2025 revenue. At 10:18 on Nov. 12 it was RMB10.34, down 0.19%, with no positive post-announcement confirmation.

Confirmation condition:A formal contract is signed, delivery timing becomes clear, and the stock later sustains relative strength versus electrical-equipment peers.

Risks and invalidation:The contract is unsigned and the revenue share is modest. Weak post-announcement support or delayed execution would make the catalyst insufficient.

Jiuri New Materials
688199.SH
Avoid

Facts and status:The transaction requires EUR225m of capital injection plus EUR26m of deferred payment into a loss-making target with negative net assets. At 10:18 on Nov. 12 it was RMB23.78, down 3.49%, extending the prior day’s sharp fall.

Confirmation condition:Reassess only after material improvement in financing, debt waivers, approvals and target cash flow, together with a clear end to price weakness.

Risks and invalidation:Cross-border approvals, additional funding, ongoing losses, negative net assets and goodwill are substantive negatives; this is not framed as a long opportunity.

Sector Rotation Board

BeneficiariesOptical, storage, chip equipment and industrial gases have A-share price confirmation.
WatchEmbodied-intelligence robots have a policy catalyst but need issuer business/order evidence; Goldcup still needs a contract and price confirmation.
PressureHong Kong technology, Hong Kong gold shares and funding-heavy deals face market or issuer-level counter-evidence.
ValidationMainland technology must stay stronger than broad indices before noon and Hang Seng Tech must stabilize; a joint fade lowers the rating.

Logic Chain

US hardware, storage and semiconductors lead → mainland optical/storage shares strengthen at the open → local confirmation of the US mapping.
NVIDIA reverses after hours → Hong Kong technology keeps falling → technology longs are limited to confirmed mainland branches.
Robot action plan plus PBOC net injection → stronger structural policy support → issuer orders and market breadth still need verification.
Guanggang rises 5.71% after its buyback filing → issuer and STAR-board confirmation → upgrade to Bullish Candidate.
Goldcup lacks confirmation and Jiuri keeps falling → issuer counter-evidence diverges → retain Conditional Watch and Avoid.

Risk Radar

NVIDIA’s after-hours reversal remains; a pre-noon mainland technology fade would weaken confirmation.
Simultaneously firmer oil and dollar increase imported-inflation and growth-valuation pressure.
Jiuri’s financing, cross-border approvals, ongoing losses and goodwill risks remain unresolved.
Goldcup still lacks post-event strength; Guanggang loses confirmation if it falls below the prior close.
Advancers trailed decliners at 09:48, so stronger indices do not yet mean a broad rally.

Sources and Timestamps

First-run cutoff: 2026-11-12 08:34 CST; incremental-review cutoff: 10:18 CST. A/H indices and candidate prices use Eastmoney delayed quotes at 10:18; A-share breadth uses a 09:48 public intraday tally. The AKShare baseline remains the Nov. 11 14:23:09 CST intraday snapshot and is not presented as today’s market. US rankings were captured by GitHub Actions/Moomoo at 10:17:24 CST, while QQQ/SPY/DIA are the latest available extended-hours ETF proxies from 08:12–08:14 CST. Policy evidence includes Beijing’s official action plan and public reporting of the PBOC operation; company facts retain SSE/CNINFO filing sources.

盘前结论

事实层面，英伟达治理危机正在扩散到AI链：NVDA、CRWV、MU、MRVL及多只数据中心股均获负反馈，纳指100期货明显弱于道指。

判断层面，开盘更可能出现“AI主线承压、竞争替代与个别财报股逆势”的结构。AMD、AVGO与TTEK具备明确正向价格反馈，但只能在开盘后继续强于各自板块时维持多头观察。

不确定性来自NVDA董事会决策、周五PPI及今晚CSCO/AMAT指引。若AMD与AVGO回吐涨幅，或纳指跌幅扩大，竞争替代交易可能迅速退化为全面风险规避。

Pre-market Takeaway

On the facts, Nvidia's governance crisis is spreading through the AI chain: NVDA, CRWV, MU, MRVL and several data-center names show negative feedback, while Nasdaq 100 futures materially lag the Dow.

Our judgment is an opening structure of AI pressure with selective substitution and earnings winners. AMD, AVGO and TTEK have clear positive price feedback, but they remain long watches only while outperforming their groups after the open.

Uncertainty comes from the NVDA board decision, Friday PPI and tonight's CSCO/AMAT outlooks. If AMD and AVGO lose their gains or Nasdaq losses widen, the substitution trade can quickly become broad risk reduction.
